results.name: Behringer Audio Mixer
results.description:
Model: Behringer Xenyx QX1002USB.

I built this model in Blender as a replica of the real thing. The connector-plugs of the cables have been copied out of a model that I downloaded from Sketchfab. Not sure which it was though...

While building this model I somewhat lost myself in non-essential details, and so it has a much higher polly count then I'm happy with. But at some point I decided to stop caring about the polly count and take it all the way and went all out. So in all honesty, this model is not ideal for using it as a part of a larger scene. Just saying...  But then again, obviously you should do whatever the * you want with it, so have fun with it if you can use it for whatever.

results.name: Stereo Mixer (Soundcraft SA-100)
results.description:
The *Soundcraft SA-100 Stereo Mixer* features five stereo/ mono channels and one master control. This 3D model has been carefully modelled and is therefore precisely to scale to its real-life counterpart. The textures have been created using Substance Painter.
All switches, dials and sliders are their own object and can therefore be easily animated. The added empties near the levels display make it easy to animate the flashing lights.
This model is perfect for animation, or set-dressing.

![](https://i.imgur.com/9DpZi22.jpg)

results.name: KitchenAid Mixer 3D Model
results.description:
The KitchenAid Mixer shown here was sent back to the manufacturer due to some broken and frayed wires sticking out from the power cord. From here it was left to sit in the back corner of a dark factory, as useful as a paper weight, collecting dust. 

This asset has gone through the modeling pipeline, with a hi res and game res being made, as well as, having the hi res' data baked onto the game res in substance painter. From there it was textured and weathered appropriately based on the story of this prop.

Update: I have been working on this prop for 3 weeks now and have learned a lot from the process. Thanks for taking the time to look at what I’ve created!
